MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 60
   C. 19
   D. 38

2. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x + 2

3. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/4
   D. 2/2

4. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 21
   C. 15
   D. 15.7

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 44
   B. 30
   C. 22
   D. 15

6. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 1

7. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27
   C. 27.7
   D. 27.6

8. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 18
   C. 7
   D. 6

9. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.6
   C. 31.7
   D. 31

10. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 1/4
   C. 1/2
   D. 3/4

11. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

12. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19
   C. 19.7
   D. 25

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
